claude.sample_unit: LLM responses (12 questions x 3 models x 2 prompt stages)

links.outcome: Effect of a plain-language prompt on readability, understandability, completeness and treatment-information quality of LLM responses
links.effect: Understandability improved (F(1,11)=55.633, P<0.001) and readability increased for all models; DISCERN total fell 11.58 (ChatGPT) and 11.00 (Claude); completeness fell for ChatGPT and Claude; actionability stayed 60%.
links.quote: Simplification improved readability and understandability but could reduce completeness and treatment-information quality.
